headline.en: ONEOK to Acquire Brazos Midstream Permian Assets for $4.425 Billion
headline.zh: ONEOK将以44.25亿美元收购Brazos Midstream二叠纪资产

summary.en: ONEOK has executed a definitive agreement to acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.425 billion. Apollo-managed funds made a $9 billion minority equity investment, and the deal includes $5 billion of debt extinguishment, moving ONEOK to 3.25x debt-to-EBITDA with no common equity issuance.
summary.zh: ONEOK已签署最终协议，以44.25亿美元收购Brazos Midstream的二叠纪Midland盆地资产。Apollo管理的基金进行了90亿美元的少数股权 投资，交易包括50亿美元的债务清偿，使ONEOK的债务对EBITDA比率降至3.25倍，且无需发行普通股。
